# Matches

The **Matches** page displays all ranked matches played in the Wesnoth Tournament Manager.

## What is this page?

The Matches page is the central hub for viewing, confirming, and managing your ranked matches. Every game you play in the tournament is recorded here.

Before viewing your matches, make sure that:

- You are using the **Ranked** add-on
- **Ranked Matches** is enabled in your player profile
- You have played at least one ranked match

For more information about setting up ranked games, see [Getting Started](/help/getting-started).

## What can you do?

- **View matches** - See all your ranked matches in a list
- **Confirm preliminary matches** - Confirm the result if the system couldn't determine it automatically
- **Inform match** - Add comments and rate your opponent after winning
- **Report match** - Confirm result, add comments, and rate opponent after losing
- **Dispute match** - Request review of a match result if you believe it's incorrect
- **View match details** - Click on any match to see full game information

## What happens when you do each action?

### View Matches

When you open the Matches page, you see all your matches in a table format:

![Match list view](/api/public/wiki/images/1781817655396_hgn6m6o.png)

*Automatically reported matches display with a white background*

Matches that were confirmed automatically appear with a white background. Matches that need your confirmation appear with a yellow background.

### Confirm Preliminary Match

When you have a yellow (preliminary) match that needs confirmation, click **"I Won"** or **"I Lost"**:

![Preliminary match confirmation button](/api/public/wiki/images/1781818945833_8ug06.png)

*Preliminary matches display with yellow background and require confirmation*

A confirmation form will appear:

![Preliminary match confirmation form](/api/public/wiki/images/1781819051699_alfi6s.png)

You can:

- Confirm the result by clicking **"Confirm"**
- Add a comment about the game
- Rate your opponent from 1-5 stars
- Cancel the confirmation if needed

Once confirmed, the match becomes a regular ranked match and your ELO rating is updated.

### Inform Match (Winner Action)

After winning a match, you can click **"Inform Match"** to add comments and rate your opponent:

![Inform Match button](/api/public/wiki/images/1781817919922_hpq8cs.png)

*The Inform Match action appears for matches you won*

This opens a form where you can:

- Add comments about the match
- Rate your opponent
- Submit your feedback

### Report Match (Loser Action)

After losing a match, you can click **"Report Match"** to confirm the result and provide feedback:

![Report Match button](/api/public/wiki/images/1781817981599_cpr72v.png)

*The Report Match action appears for matches you lost*

You can:

- Confirm the match result
- Add comments
- Rate your opponent
- Request a dispute if you believe the result is incorrect

### Dispute Match

If you believe a match result is incorrect, you can request a dispute:

![Dispute request form](/api/public/wiki/images/1781819051699_alfi6s.png)

When you open a dispute:

- Provide a brief explanation of why you're disputing the result
- A moderator or administrator will review your claim
- They will either accept or reject the dispute
- If accepted, the match is cancelled and ELO changes are reverted

### Match Statuses

Matches can have different statuses depending on their state:

**Reported** - The match was just created and only one player has confirmed it.

![Reported match status](/api/public/wiki/images/1781818545716_b3x044.png)

**Confirmed** - Both players have confirmed the match result.

**Cancelled** - The match was cancelled (usually due to an accepted dispute). Cancelled matches display with a red background.

![Cancelled match display](/api/public/wiki/images/1781818721602_2x0psi.png)

*Cancelled matches appear with red background and show no ELO change*

The replay file remains available for download even after cancellation.
